english.title: Sell / transfer expanding ammunition - military equipment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of the Secretary of State sold or transferred ammunition, namely **(..SPECIFY AMMUNITION..), which incorporated a missile designed or adapted to expand on impact
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1A)(f) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) Amended by section 9 of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1997 to prohibit all expanding ammunition with effect from 1.7.97.
(ii) Holders of such ammunition before 1.7.97 by virtue of a firearms certificate, visitor's firearms permit or a permit issued under section 7 of the 1968 Act are exempt until 1.10.97.
(iii) See section 5A for other exemptions.
(iv) Section 5(7)(c) provides that a missile expanding on impact includes a missile deforming in any predictable manner on or immediately after impact.
(v) Pistol is not defined in the Firearms legislation. However, the ordinary dictionary meaning is a 'hand held firearm'.
(vi) See also offence wordings at H2795 and H4333.
